settings.title: Stats and privacy
settings.no_count: Don't count my reads and visits in other members' stats
settings.share_audience: Include my age and gender in other members' audience stats (only totals of 10 or more are ever shown)

settings.count_guests_help: Guests' reads are counted from their browser: one small request each time a guest leaves a discussion. Crawlers and Global Privacy Control are skipped. Turn this off to count members only, with no extra requests.
settings.post_views_help: Show each post's view count under it.
settings.post_views_everyone: To everyone allowed by the "See views under posts" permission
settings.demographics_help: Members can share their birth year and gender for audience stats. Off until a member chooses it; under-18s are never counted in a band, and a bar needs 10 readers or more. Mention this in your privacy policy if you turn it on.
settings.country_source_help: Automatic uses a proxy's country header (such as Cloudflare's) and otherwise downloads DB-IP's free country file to this server once a month. IP addresses are never stored.
settings.country_header_help: Used when a proxy in front of the forum sends the visitor's country. Cloudflare's is CF-IPCountry.
settings.retention_help: Older days are merged into one row per month, so "All time" keeps working. Hourly, country and audience breakdowns are kept for 90 days.
settings.dbip_error: The last country file download failed: {error}

gdpr.export_description: Your Vantage statistics (views, visits and engagement per day).
gdpr.delete_description: Deletes your Vantage statistics. Counts you added to other members' statistics hold no trace of you.
